items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents were close to Rs. 8 crores as of 31st March, providing 10 to 12 months of runway.
items.quote: So, right now, in case if you look at as of 31st of March, we had cash and cash equivalent put together close to about Rs. 8 Crores. So, even right now, it stands there about 10 to 12 months runway we have.

items.statement: Company announced three warrant issuances totaling almost Rs. 1.5 billion over 18 months; Rs. 120 million received in Feb 2024, Rs. 100 million expected in 2 weeks, Rs. 150 million post AGM on June 27
items.quote: The company announced 3 warrant issuances, the first one being Rs. 448.2 million, of which Rs. 120 million was received by the company in February 2024. Rs. 400 million of warrants was also announced by the company in April 2024 for which shareholders have given their approval on May 22 nd and the money, which is Rs. 100 million is expected into the company over the course of the next 2 weeks. Yes

items.statement: Granted 230,000 ESOP shares at INR27 with four-year vesting; 15 million shares reserved for employees
items.quote: See, we have granted 2,30,000 shares to four individuals that are critical to our organization at the rate of INR27 and the vesting period is four years. Total we have blocked 15,000,000 shares for our employees.

items.statement: Mauritius Fund invested INR10 crores via warrants; INR2.5 crores already paid, balance INR7.5 crores expected by half-year end
items.quote: See, that shouldn't be an issue. See, I think you might be aware that Mauritius Fund has invested about INR10 crores in our share of the warrants issue, INR2.5 crores they already put in. And I think then, say, before the end of the next, this thing, half year closing, they put the balance of INR7.5 crores.

items.statement: Management aims to reduce inventory days and debtor days to improve working capital.
items.quote: we'll definitely try to reduce the inventory days and the debtors days . But it will be because the ratio remains the same. So, working capital also remains the same.

items.statement: Promoter pledges at 63% due to Rs. 130 crore loan against shares for warrants investment and collateral for IREDA/PFC loans; IREDA/PFC pledge to release in 2-3 years, promoter loan pledge may reduce in 6 months.
items.quote: The first pledge is where we have taken a promoter funding to invest in the warrants round. So, the warrants round of Rs. 900 crores has a promoter investment of Rs. 130 crores. So, we have raised money by pledging the shares and we are going to invest that into Gensol.

items.statement: Zenith Multi Trading's 1.37% holding is frozen by government authorities; no communication from authorities on intent to sell or buy shares.
items.quote: I think, as of what our knowledge is, the Zenith Multi Trading shares are in a freeze, which is there. So, I think it is the freeze is with the government authorities.

items.statement: Negative operating cash flow of Rs. 98 crore in FY24 due to Q4 revenue spike; ~Rs. 170-180 crore receivables from last 45 days of Q4 already converting to cash in Q1 FY25.
items.quote: Our Q4FY '24 was greater than actually the full year of FY '23. The last 45 days, as you would imagine, will always be receivables for us. So, if we did in the last quarter about close to Rs. 350-380 crores of revenue, out of which about Rs. 180-190 crores will be receivables because the last 45 days will not get translated into cash.

items.statement: Current assets include Rs. 227 crore trade receivables, Rs. 380 crore cash, Rs. 88 crore retention money, Rs. 8 crore warrant application money, and Rs. 139 crore work-in-progress.
items.quote: Yes, the current asset is about Rs. 227 crores is trade receivable and about close to Rs. 380 crores is the cash which is there about, so yes, so that these are the two major constituents of the current assets.

items.statement: Rs. 900 crore warrants round committed; promoter investing Rs. 130 crore; round to open in early June 2024, first tranche expected by June 30.
items.quote: We have not received the money. We have not opened the round yet. We expect to open the round as the company was having very healthy cash balance. We are going to open up o ur round in the early part of June is when we are going to open up the round

items.statement: Receivable days increased by roughly 17 days, with 13 days due to revenue growth; credit loss provision rose 70-75% and a credit control team has been set up.
items.quote: So, receivable has gone up roughly by 17 days and out of these 13 days is on account of growth in revenue and few debtors are also there. However, we do the -- We don't have much credit loss. Credit loss has increased only by 70%, 75% in this year, which have been provided in the books.

items.statement: Operating cash flow increased to INR3,492 million in FY24 from INR2,493 million in FY23
items.quote: During the year, our operating cash flow generation remained healthy. We recorded an increase in net cash flow generation from operating activities to INR3,492 million versus INR2,493 million in FY23.

items.statement: CFO states current debt level is INR109 crores with INR76 crores from working capital and INR33 crores term loan for commercial vehicles
items.quote: Currently, we have a debt level of INR109 crores, out of which INR76 crores is contributing from a working capital side and the rest is from a term-loan, which has been taken for the commercial vehicle, which is being utilized for our shipping division.

items.statement: Management deferred the rights issue proposal and plans to consider it at an appropriate time later.
items.quote: So we have given intimation for the rights issue, but later we deferred this agenda. The proposal was placed for the Board of Directors, but the management along with the Independent Directors of the company were in the opinion to defer the proposal of issuance of rights issue at a later date and for consideration at an appropriate time.

items.statement: Promoter holding has remained around 34% since IPO in 1995 with no dilution planned for the next 3-4 years.
items.quote: Since, the day of IPO in 1995, our promoter holding has been around the same mark. And there is no dilution planned or even in our mind -set to dilute further. And we would be maintaining this promoter holding for the next 3 years, 4 years at least.

items.statement: NCD of Rs 15 crore committed and expected to be allocated within 30 days
items.quote: Regarding the fundraise, I am sure some of you saw our announcement on the Bombay Stock Exchange about raising an NCD worth about 15 crores. We have been blown away by the response from subscribers. From a commitment perspective, it is already committed, and we believe the entire 15 crores will be allocated within the next 30 days.

items.statement: Board approval obtained for equity raise of ₹50-100 crore in FY25, expected to close in one or two months
items.quote: We've already obtained board approval for the equity raise. Therefore, we plan to secure ₹50-100 crore in equity during this fiscal year

items.statement: Equity raise of ₹50-100 crore planned for FY25, expected to close in one or two months
items.quote: No, no. So, we are thinking we will close it in one or two months as quickly as possible.

items.statement: Liquidity position strong with liquid funds of ₹82 crores including ₹17 crores of undrawn funds
items.quote: The company's liquidity position remains strong, with liquid funds of ₹82 crores, including ₹17 crores of undrawn funds.

items.statement: Converted 6.93 lakh equity shares against share warrants in Q4 FY24
items.quote: We successfully converted 6.93 lakh equity shares against share warrants.

items.statement: Working capital cycle improved to 70-75 days from 340+ days in FY21 through better collections and inventory management
items.quote: Currently, I think working capital cycle is around 70 to 75 days.

items.statement: Working capital days reduced from 340+ in FY21 to around 270 through collection efforts and supply chain optimization
items.quote: So see basically there were some efforts done on our part for the collection as well. The marketing team has already started working on identifying customers. There were some issues were there which were holding some payments with the OEM which we were able to sort it out and got it in our system. So that way we were able to and simultaneously as I told you our supply chain has worked very hard to

items.statement: Rights issue is in process with lead manager; update expected within four weeks
items.quote: Sir, it's in the process with the lead manager and I think we s hould be having an update by four weeks from now

items.statement: Total debt repaid in FY24 was around Rs 2.13 crore
items.quote: Total debt repaid in FY 23-24 was around Rs.2,12,66,000/-

items.statement: CFO states present CapEx is around INR 15 crore as of May 2024
items.quote: Present we have around 15 CR CapEx. So we are planning yeah. Yeah. We are planning to have some more machineries, technological machine s and equipment in future so we can enhance our productivity also with the new technologies we will have increase in the ROCE
